title: Contact
description: A contact point for a business or party. At least one of `email` or `phone_number` is required.

type.description: Role of the contact channel. Well-known values: `general`, `customer_support`, `admin`, `legal`. Open vocabulary; a Platform MUST ignore unrecognized values.

name.description: Optional human-readable label or department name for this contact point (e.g., `'Customer Care'`).

phone_number.description: Contact phone number in E.164 format (e.g., `'+12125550100'`).
